findings: The production diff contains none of the prior or fresh review labels and no held-out entity or package names.

The production diff introduces no fixture/golden reads, embedded source or SVG data, source-line equality predicate, coordinate/dimension predicate, count ladder, or parity-affecting numeric constant.
The creation-ordered shared quark index is mechanism-shaped and passes both creation-order reversals, phantom-group participation, separator-none first-created reuse, and all 51 prior controls.

The implementation adds quark order without unifying namespace-separator state: namespace_sep is replaced, but namespace_sep_none remains true after a non-none separator command and continues selecting RE_DOTTED.

The renderer's Package.entities vector is a flattened transitive leaf-membership projection. Using entities.is_empty as group liveness cannot reproduce Entity.isEmpty, which is defined over direct quark children and distinguishes a directly empty package from a parent whose child group is empty.
The narrow renderer unit test asserts only an isolated empty Package value and therefore encodes the incomplete response model rather than Java's nested group behavior.

findings.title: namespaceSeparator none remains sticky after a non-none transition
evidence: review7_separator_none_to_colon_qualified_declaration.puml is valid Java syntax and its SVG is not an error page.
CommandNamespaceSeparator.executeArg replaces the separator on every command.
Rust sets namespace_sep to :: but never clears namespace_sep_none, so try_entity_decl continues using RE_DOTTED.
The stale lexical mode creates an extra root ColonRealm entity and shifts the intended qualified leaf and phantom-group source lines from declaration line 4 to relationship line 5.

findings.title: Flattened leaf membership erases nested empty-group clusters
evidence: review7_nested_empty_groups_only.puml is valid Java syntax and its SVG is not an error page.
Java Entity.isEmpty returns false when a group has any direct nonremoved child, including an empty child group.
GraphvizImageBuilder therefore emits EmptyOuter and EmptyOuter.EmptyRight as clusters while rendering their directly empty children as EMPTY_PACKAGE leaves.
Rust is_rendered_package_cluster rejects every package whose flattened entities vector is empty, so it erases both parent clusters.
This contradicts review-6-response.md's rendered-descendant formulation: Java's relevant distinction is direct quark-child structure, not eventual ownership of a rendered leaf.
